summary.pack_description:
Go on a journey through some of the most breathtaking goals scored over the past two decades with Light the Lamp: Legacy. From jaw-dropping dekes to fake shots, Light the Lamp: Legacy captures the essence of what makes hockey so exhilarating, showcasing the unforgettable highlights that have left fans in awe. Featuring thrilling lamp-lighters from Connor McDavid, Rick Nash, Sidney Crosby, Jonathan Toews, Zdeno Chara, Ryan Getzlaf, and more!

Each pack contains 1 Light the Lamp: Legacy highlight, 2 Across the Pond highlights, and 1 mystery highlight that could be from Across the Pond (75%), Light the Lamp: Legacy (15%), Opening Ice: Icons (7%), or Cause for a Celly: 2010s (3%).

release.name: Light the Lamp: Legacy Debut LE Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Tuesday, Oct 8 at 1pm ET / 10am PT

Sweepstakes: Each pack purchased between Jan 3, 2025 at 12:01:01am ET and Jan 18, 2025 at 11:59:59pm ET is an entry for a chance to win a trip to the NHL Stadium Series™ . Read the blog announcement and official rules (version Française) for more information. No purchase necessary to enter.

 

Price: $25 USD

# Packs Available: 2000 packs total. Edition numbers are distributed randomly.

 

Purchase Limit: Fifteen (15) pack limit per person for the first 24 hours; limit increased to thirty (30) pack limit per person afterwards. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 4

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • One (1) highlight from Light the Lamp: Legacy (Limited #/500)
  • Two (2) highlights from Across the Pond (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 75% Across the Pond (Core #/1500)
    • 15% Light the Lamp: Legacy (Limited #/500) 
    • 7% Opening Ice: Icons (Rare #/250) 
    • 3% Cause for a Celly: 2010s (Epic #/100)

 

Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe. Payment via cryptocurrency is also available. See these FAQs for a complete list of supported currencies.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Highlights List
  • Across the Pond, Series 2 - Preview
  • Light the Lamp: Legacy, Series 2 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: Icons, Series 2 - Preview
  • Cause for a Celly: 2010s, Series 2 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 2 highlights will only be distributed during Series 2, which ends prior to the start of the 2025-26 Regular Season. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Light the Lamp: Legacy
summary.description: Toe drags, "Michigan" goals, spin-o-ramas—there's nothing quite like the thrill of lighting the lamp. In Light the Lamp: Legacy, we take you on a journey through some of the most breathtaking goals scored over the past two decades. This Limited set is a tribute to the incredible skill, creativity, and sheer brilliance that define the NHL. From jaw-dropping dekes to fake shots, Light the Lamp: Legacy captures the essence of what makes hockey so exhilarating, showcasing the unforgettable highlights that have left fans in awe.

summary.name: Across the Pond
summary.description: In October 1997, the NHL made history by playing its first regular-season games outside North America, in Tokyo, Japan. Since then, numerous games have been held overseas, including the NHL Premiere Series and the current NHL Global Series across Europe. Across the Pond celebrates some of the most memorable highlights from these international games, featuring both retired and active players. Relives unforgettable plays like a hat trick scored in a home country, a game-deciding shootout save, or a first career goal in this globetrotting Core set.

summary.name: Opening Ice: Icons
summary.description: Introducing Opening Ice: Icons, a Rare set that immortalizes the unforgettable moments when legendary players scored their first NHL goals. Relive the sheer joy and determination as these icons achieve their first milestone in the NHL. Opening Ice: Icons celebrates the origins of hockey’s great heroes and commemorates the beginnings of remarkable careers.

summary.name: Cause for a Celly: 2010s
summary.description: Cause for a Celly: 2010s immortalizes many unforgettable NHL playoff highlights that helped define the sport, featuring some of the game's greatest players and iconic plays that have left an indelible mark on hockey history. From stunning overtime goals to game-saving glove saves, Cause for a Celly: 2010s captures the drama, passion, and intensity of the playoffs like never before. This Epic set delves into the annals of NHL history, bringing to life the brilliance of great players and the unforgettable plays that have shaped the postseason.
